TL;DR: NEEDLE 通过在高维机器人演示的观测之间添加简短且经过验证的动作桥接，实现离线数据集增强，无需新环境交互，在真实机器人任务上显著提升成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人演示中即使单条轨迹效率低或失败，也可能包含有用行为；轨迹拼接可整合这些行为生成更好的训练数据，但在高维机器人数据中识别有效连接并验证其可行性很困难，现有方法多依赖低维状态表示。

Method: NEEDLE 是一种离线数据集增强算法。首先仅使用 RGB 图像、本体感知和回合级结果，在记录的观测之间识别并创建能绕过次优绕路、扩大动作覆盖、并利用失败轨迹增强数据集的连接；然后提出一种采样技术，将接受的动作桥接纳入策略训练，无需合成中间图像或丢弃原始演示。

Result: 在真实机器人任务上，NEEDLE 相比每个任务中最强基线平均提升 21 个百分点的成功率。

Conclusion: NEEDLE 证明了在高维视觉条件下通过验证动作桥接进行轨迹拼接与数据集增强的可行性，可在不增加环境交互的情况下提升策略性能。

Abstract: Robot demonstrations may contain useful behavior even when individual episodes are inefficient or unsuccessful. Trajectory stitching offers a way to compose these behaviors into improved training data, but identifying useful connections and verifying their feasibility is difficult in high-dimensional robot data, where many prior methods rely on low-dimensional state representations. We introduce NEEDLE, an offline dataset-augmentation algorithm that addresses these challenges by adding short, verified action bridges between recorded observations in high-dimensional robot demonstrations. First, NEEDLE identifies and creates connections that bypass suboptimal detours, broaden action coverage, and augment the original dataset with failed trajectories, using only RGB images, proprioception, and episode-level outcomes, without new environment interaction or privileged object state. Next, we present a sampling technique that incorporates accepted bridges into policy training without synthesizing intermediate images or discarding the original demonstrations, allowing policies to learn alternative actions while retaining the original dataset's coverage. On real-robot tasks, NEEDLE improves success rate over the strongest baseline on each task by an average of 21 percentage points. Videos and supplementary materials are on https://needle-work.github.io/.

</details>


### [105] [Filter-Aware Fine-Tuning for Safe Humanoid Whole-Body Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02341)
*Pranit Mohnot,Christian Helten,Daniele Gammelli,Marco Pavone*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文揭示人形机器人跟踪策略与运行时安全过滤器之间的失配问题，提出过滤器感知微调方法CoFiT，显著降低约束违反时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人全身运动安全至关重要。现有方法将参考运动生成与执行分离，由强化学习策略跟踪参考，再用控制屏障函数等安全过滤器施加约束。但将跟踪策略与安全过滤器独立处理会引发根本性失配：过滤会改变执行动作及诱导的状态分布。

Method: 通过案例研究隔离动力学、目标函数与信息三类失配，分析其根本原因；据此提出CoFiT（约束过滤器感知微调），一种针对预训练跟踪器的过滤器感知微调方法。

Result: 在多种约束场景下，相比仅过滤器训练，CoFiT在TWIST2上将违反时间减少91%，在SONIC上减少21%，且所需安全过滤修正更小。在Unitree G1硬件上，TWIST2违反时间减少83%，所有试验无需操作员干预，而基线有50%试验需操作员中止。

Conclusion: 研究提供了策略-过滤器交互的可操作洞见，并确立了将学习型跟踪器与运行时安全过滤器整合的设计原则。

Abstract: Safe whole-body motion is essential for deploying humanoid robots in unstructured environments. Modern humanoid control commonly separates reference specification from execution, with a planner, teleoperator, or motion generator providing a reference that a reinforcement-learning policy tracks through dynamically feasible whole-body control. Runtime safety filters, such as control barrier functions (CBFs), offer a promising approach for enforcing newly introduced constraints via interventions on the tracker's outputs. We show, however, that treating the tracking policy and safety filter independently induces fundamental mismatches, as filtering alters both the executed actions and the induced state distribution. We study this policy-filter interface through case studies that isolate dynamics, objective, and information mismatches, highlight their root causes, and use these insights to develop CoFiT (Constrained Filter-aware Tuning), a filter-aware fine-tuning method for pretrained trackers. Across diverse constraint scenes, CoFiT reduces violation time relative to filter-only training by 91% on TWIST2 and 21% on SONIC, while requiring smaller safety filter corrections. On Unitree G1 hardware, CoFiT reduces violation time by 83% for TWIST2 and completes every trial without operator intervention, whereas 50% of baseline trials require an operator stop. Together, these results provide actionable insights into policy-filter interactions and establish design principles for integrating learned trackers with runtime safety filters.

</details>


### [106] [SocialVLA: A Social Perception Gateway for Human-Reaction-Based Failure Detection and Recovery in VLA Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02360)
*Sofya Konstantinova,Miguel Altamirano Cabrera,Artem Lykov,Dzmitry Tsetserukou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 SocialVLA，一个局部、策略无关的社会感知网关，把人类自发的语言外声音、面部/视觉反应和显式停止语转化为 VLA 操作策略的运行时中断信号，并在 Unitree G1 真机上验证其召回率、精度和延迟表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 策略虽能完成多样化的机器人操作，但执行中往往无法识别自身错误；而人类旁观者的即时反应（声音、面部、语言）可在失败完成前提供互补的纠错信号，因此需要一种把这类自发社会反应转化为运行时干预信号的机制。

Method: SocialVLA 整合因果语言外音频检测、视觉反应识别、显式停止短语和机器人相关性估计；采用异步首事件融合机制，用最早达到足够置信度的信号触发 VLA 暂停，并通过独立语音通道捕获口头纠正，用于继续、重启或修改指令。在 Unitree G1 上进行物理实验，15 名参与者、238 个标注的值得干预片段和 1.038 小时非干预行为；另在未见过的第 16 名参与者上做前瞻部署测试。

Result: 冻结离线回放达到 54.6% 召回率和 69.5% 精度，未过滤的音视频融合召回率达 64.3%；相关性估计将误停片段从 100 降至 57，精度从 60.5% 提升到 69.8%；前瞻部署中达到 59.5% 召回率和 91.7% 精度。检测到融合的中位延迟为 47.9 ms，VLA 门控到物理暂停为 336 ms，反应发生到暂停为 1.021 s。

Conclusion: 结果表明存在一条完整的局部通路，可从自发社会反应直达 VLA 的物理中断，并支持由参与者引导的恢复。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies enable diverse robotic manipulation but can fail during execution without recognizing their own errors. Human observers provide complementary signals, as unexpected robot behavior can trigger rapid vocal, facial, or verbal reactions before failure is completed. We introduce SocialVLA, a local, policy-agnostic social perception gateway that converts spontaneous human reactions into runtime intervention signals for VLA manipulation. SocialVLA combines causal paralinguistic audio detection, visual reaction recognition, explicit stop phrases, and robot-relevance estimation. An asynchronous first-event fusion mechanism triggers a VLA hold from the earliest sufficiently confident signal, while a separate speech channel captures verbal corrections for participant-directed continuation, restart, or instruction revision. We evaluate SocialVLA on physical Unitree G1 manipulation using 15 participants, with 238 annotated intervention-worthy episodes and 1.038 h of non-intervention behavior. Frozen offline replay achieves 54.6% recall and 69.5% precision, while unfiltered audio-video fusion reaches 64.3% recall. Relevance estimation reduces false-stop episodes from 100 to 57 and increases precision from 60.5% to 69.8%. In prospective deployment on an unseen 16th participant, the frozen system achieves 59.5% recall and 91.7% precision. Median detector-to-fusion latency is 47.9 ms, VLA-gate-to-physical-hold latency is 336 ms, and reaction-onset-to-hold latency is 1.021 s. These results demonstrate a complete local pathway from spontaneous social reaction to physical VLA interruption and participant-directed recovery.

</details>


### [107] [Rethinking World-Action Model for Compositional and In-Context Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02368)
*Shukai Gong,Xuanran Zhai,Yintianrun Zhang,Ruopeng Cui,Ye Huang,Yiyang Fu,Dexuan Lyu,Chaojie Li,Xinyi Song,Peiwen Lin,Chuang Wang,Mingyuan Jia,Yufan Deng,Jiaxin Fang,Bo Liang,Jiaxin Li,Yuxiang Gao,Hao Liu,Daquan Zhou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出ViGAR分层框架，将操作任务分解为视觉子目标规划器与执行器，共享世界模型表征，在RoboTwin基准和真机任务上显著优于基线，并支持上下文学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界-动作模型（WAMs）虽能联合预测短时程视觉未来与动作，但缺乏显式的子任务级别推理，难以应对真实部署中长时程、多子任务协调的组合式操作需求。

Method: ViGAR将操作分解为两级：视觉子目标规划器根据当前观测与全局指令预测下一子任务的视觉子目标；子目标执行器以此为条件联合生成未来视觉轨迹与动作。两个组件共享预训练世界模型表征。框架还天然支持上下文学习，以全局目标图像作为上下文即可在不更新参数的情况下诱导不同的子任务分解与行为。

Result: 在RoboTwin Clean2Random基准上，Clean与Random设置下成功率分别为82.00%和67.02%，平均成功率超最强基线12.86个百分点；五个组合操作任务与两个上下文学习任务的真实机器人实验进一步验证了有效性。

Conclusion: 显式子任务级分层规划结合共享世界模型表征，能有效提升长时程组合操作的成功率与泛化性，并赋予模型无需参数更新的上下文适应能力。

Abstract: Long-horizon compositional manipulation has become increasingly important for real-world robot deployment, where a single task involves multiple coordinated subtasks. Existing world-action models (WAMs) jointly predict short-horizon visual futures and actions, but typically lack explicit subtask-level reasoning. We propose Visual Goal-conditioned Action Reasoning (ViGAR), a hierarchical framework that factorizes manipulation into a visual subgoal planner and a subgoal executor. Given the current observation and global instruction, the subgoal planner predicts a visual subgoal for the next subtask. The subgoal executor then jointly generates future visual trajectories and actions conditioned on the predicted subgoal. Both components share a pretrained world-model representation, enabling task-level planning and action generation to benefit from common physical knowledge. Moreover, our framework naturally supports in-context learning: using a global goal image as context can induce different subtask decompositions and behaviors without parameter updates. On the RoboTwin Clean2Random benchmark, ViGAR achieves 82.00% and 67.02% success rates under the Clean and Random settings, respectively, surpassing the strongest baseline by 12.86 percentage points in average success rate. Real-world robot experiments on five compositional and two in-context learning tasks further confirm the effectiveness of ViGAR.

</details>


### [108] [Keep the Effect, Drop the Actor: Programmable Effect-to-Execution World-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02398)
*Junyi Hu,Zhewen He,Zhenhua Li,Yi Fang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出将机器人演示编译为"效应程序"（物体3D关键点轨迹+抓取点+终态），用71.5M参数的世界-动作模型PEWAM以四流独立流匹配生成执行，实现可编程、可编辑、跨本体、抗扰动的闭环策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 演示同时记录了"物体发生了什么"和"机械臂如何做到"。作者选择以"效应"为条件，从而把不同本体、不同演示者的执行细节解耦，让技能可迁移、可编辑、可重解。

Method: 将单条演示编译为效应程序：移动物体的3D关键点轨迹、标记抓取位置的两点、去除演示者后的场景终态配置。PEWAM（71.5M参数）联合生成效应、机器人执行、动作、终态四个流，各流有独立流匹配时间。推理时钳制程序、采样执行流，等价于"编程"，并从实时场景闭环重解。

Result: LIBERO-Goal留出任务：单条演示程序完成90个episode中的40个，而同一骨干以目标图像或语言为条件、以及已发表的演示条件方法最多19个；Meta-World三个留出类别超过最佳已发表结果（五类均值未超过）。程序可人工编辑（平移终态改变放置、旋转接触点改变抓取）。同一程序无需重训练在四款机械臂上运行；被推动后重解完成60个episode中的23个，演示回放仅6个。Franka上基于其他任务真实演示微调后，单段人类视频编译的程序完成40次试验中的36次，视频末帧作目标图像条件仅22次。

Conclusion: 以"效应"而非"目标图像/语言/完整轨迹"为条件，把演示编译为可编辑坐标程序，能显著提升单演示数据效率、跨本体迁移与扰动鲁棒性，并支持人类视频零演示迁移。

Abstract: A robot demonstration records two things in the same frames: what happened to the objects, and how one particular arm made it happen. We condition on the first. A demonstration is compiled into an effect program: the 3D keypoint trajectories of the objects that moved, two points marking where each was held, and the configuration the scene ends in, with the demonstrator removed. PEWAM, a 71.5M-parameter world-action model, generates effect, robot execution, action and terminal state as four streams with independent flow-matching times, so clamping a program and sampling the execution turns inference into programming, re-solved closed loop from the live scene. On held-out LIBERO-Goal tasks, one demonstration's program completes 40 of 90 episodes, where the same backbone given a goal image or language, and published demonstration-conditioned methods, complete at most 19; on three of Meta-World's held-out classes it exceeds the best published results, though not on the five-class mean. Because a program is a set of coordinates, a person can edit it: the placement follows a shifted terminal state and the grasp turns with rotated contact points. The same program runs on four robot arms without retraining, and after a push, re-solving completes 23 of 60 episodes where replaying the demonstration completes 6. On a Franka arm, fine-tuned on real demonstrations of other tasks, programs compiled from single human videos complete 36 of 40 trials, against 22 for the same backbone conditioned on the video's last frame as a goal image.

</details>


### [109] [Autonomous mobile robot operations logistics: a dataset of jobs, dispatch events and robot states](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02428)
*Jan-Felix Klein,Yongkuk Jeong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了MoRoOp数据集，记录自主移动机器人（AMR）在实验室物料配送场景下连续九个八小时班次的运行数据，涵盖作业生成、调度与机器人控制全流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AMR在生产物流中承担物料运输，其运行由作业生成、调度和机器人控制共同决定，但缺乏真实运行环境下链接作业规范、调度事件与机器人状态观测的完整数据集，制约了AI代理评估、扰动检测等研究。

Method: 在实验室套件准备与补给场景中，AMR按随机生成的套件补给、空箱回收和充电作业运行，连续采集九个八小时班次的数据，记录作业规范、构成作业的操作、记录操作状态转换与结果的调度事件，以及包含位置、姿态、速度、各轮电量与诊断信息的机器人状态观测，并提供原始与清洗后的机器人状态表。

Result: 数据集包含1,382个作业、4,815个操作、19,352个调度事件和140,386条机器人状态观测，以及作业生成所用的套件规范；保留了真实运行中出现的延迟、导航受阻和操作失败等技术上有效的观测。

Conclusion: MoRoOp为AMR运行研究提供了真实场景的多层级数据资源，可支持AI代理在运行决策记录上的评估、扰动检测、操作预测、数据驱动仿真和事件日志分析等复用方向。

Abstract: Autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) increasingly perform material transport in production logistics, where their operation is governed by job generation, dispatching and robot control. We present MoRoOp, a dataset of AMR operations recorded in a laboratory kit preparation and supply scenario over nine eight-hour shifts. During each shift, an AMR executed stochastically generated kit supply, empty-box refill and charging jobs. The dataset links job specifications, the operations constituting each job, dispatch events documenting operation state transitions and outcomes, and robot-state observations comprising position, orientation, velocity, per-wheel state of charge and diagnostics. It contains 1,382 jobs, 4,815 operations, 19,352 dispatch events and 140,386 robot-state observations together with the kit specifications used during job generation. The dataset was recorded in an operating laboratory environment, and technically valid observations of delays, obstructed navigation and unsuccessful operations were retained. Both raw and cleaned robot-state tables are provided. Documented reuse directions include the evaluation of AI agents on operational decision records, disturbance detection, operation prediction, data-driven simulation and event-log analysis.

</details>


### [110] [OpenRUA: Robot-Use Agents Are Zero-Shot Visuomotor Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02459)
*Zhaoyang Chu,Earl T. Barr,Claire Le Goues,Peter O'Hearn,Mark Harman,Federica Sarro,He Ye*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 OpenRUA，一种"零抽象"harness，仅让现成编码 agent 通过终端访问机器人原生软件接口 ROS 2，从而在无需定制工作流与专用接口的情况下完成机器人操控任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往让编码 agent 控制机器人时，研究者往往需要构建复杂的定制 harness，规定专门工作流并提供定制接口。作者质疑这种额外工程是否必要，希望验证现成编码 agent 能否直接利用机器人领域成熟的软件栈（ROS 2）完成任务。

Method: OpenRUA 采用"工作区即 harness"的极简设计：仅向编码 agent 提供终端访问 ROS 2 的能力、ROS 2 文档和基础工具，不对 agent 工作流做任何编排。其核心思路是将感知重构为文件 I/O，将操控重构为编码；使用 Claude Code（Claude Opus 5 驱动）作为 agent。

Result: 在 CaP-Bench 上成功率达 99.0%，在 LIBERO-PRO 上达 87.0%，表明现成编码 agent 可无需定制原语和任务特定训练，直接充当零样本视觉运动策略。进一步分析发现显著涌现行为：96.80% 的回合中 agent 自发编写程序处理原始传感输入并推导度量测量；95.87% 的回合中自发构建运动控制客户端（如夹爪控制），50.13% 的回合中构建闭环控制程序（如基于传感反馈调整运动）。

Conclusion: 研究表明，额外的 harness 工程并非必要；通过让现成编码 agent 直接使用机器人原生接口，即可实现高效的机器人感知与操控，且会自发涌现出感知处理、运动控制客户端构建与闭环控制等行为。

Abstract: Coding agents are extending their reach into the physical world by writing and executing robot control programs. One might expect the agents to use the existing mature software stack that engineers have developed over decades to access sensors and control motion. Yet prior work primarily engineers complex custom harnesses to orchestrate agents for robot use, particularly by prescribing specialized workflows and providing bespoke interfaces. This raises the question: "Is such additional harness engineering necessary?" We introduce OpenRUA, a zero-abstraction harness that bypasses bespoke abstraction layers by providing off-the-shelf coding agents with only terminal access to the robot's native software interface ROS 2. OpenRUA employs a minimalist workspace-as-harness design, only offering ROS 2 documentation and basic tools while leaving the coding agent to organize its own work without orchestrating any agentic workflow. Within this workspace, OpenRUA recasts perception as file I/O and manipulation as coding. With Claude Code powered by Claude Opus 5, OpenRUA achieves success rates of 99.0% on CaP-Bench and 87.0% on LIBERO-PRO, demonstrating that an off-the-shelf coding agent can serve as a zero-shot visuomotor policy through the robot's native interface, without bespoke primitives or task-specific training. Under this minimalist design, further analysis reveals striking emergent behaviors of coding agents: (1) For perception, the agent spontaneously writes programs that process raw sensory inputs and derive metric measurements in 96.80% of episodes. (2) For manipulation, the agent spontaneously builds motion-control clients (e.g., gripper control) in 95.87% of episodes and closed-loop control programs (e.g., adjusting motion based on sensor feedback) in 50.13% of episodes. Our code is available at https://github.com/terminalworld/OpenRUA.

</details>


### [111] [RUL-Aware RRT*: Degradation-Balanced Motion Planning for Robotic Manipulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02469)
*Haibo Li,Zhiguo Zeng,Xu Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 针对机械臂长期运行中关节退化不均导致最早失效的问题，本文提出RUL-aware RRT*运动规划方法，将关节剩余使用寿命信息融入规划过程，自适应调整关节使用，在三种场景下验证其抑制退化失衡、延缓瓶颈失效的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机械臂长时间运行时关节退化不均匀，最薄弱执行器提前失效，造成非计划停机和重大运行损失；传统运动规划不考虑关节健康状况，反而会加剧这种失衡。

Method: 提出RUL-aware RRT*运动规划方法，在规划中引入关节剩余使用寿命（RUL）信息，并根据健康状况变化自适应调整各关节的使用程度。

Result: 在三种代表性场景（全健康场景FHS、异质退化场景HDS、局部退化场景LDS）中评估，结果表明该方法能有效抑制退化失衡、延缓瓶颈失效的出现，并提升系统长期运行的可靠性。

Conclusion: 将健康反馈融入运动规划，是提升持续磨损下机械臂耐久性与运行韧性的实用且稳健的途径。

Abstract: Robotic manipulators operating over long durations often experience uneven joint degradation, which causes the weakest actuator to fail prematurely, leads to unplanned downtime, and results in significant operational losses. Traditional motion-planning algorithms do not account for joint health conditions and therefore tend to exacerbate this imbalance during extended operation. To address this challenge, this study introduces the RUL-aware RRT*, a motion-planning method that incorporates joint remaining useful life information into the planning process and adaptively adjusts joint usage in response to evolving health conditions. The method is evaluated across three representative scenarios, namely the Full Health Scenario (FHS), the Heterogeneous Degradation Scenario (HDS), and the Local Degradation Scenario (LDS). The results show that the RUL-aware RRT* effectively suppresses degradation imbalance, delays the emergence of bottleneck failures, and improves the long-term reliability of the robotic system during extended operation. These findings demonstrate that integrating health feedback into motion planning provides a practical and robust pathway for enhancing the durability and operational resilience of manipulators subject to continuous wear.

</details>


### [112] [CriticHack: Evaluating Visual Rewards Under Robot Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02527)
*Jiaxuan Luo,Xingguo Xu,Shanshan Wang,Yuhan Zhou,Zhen Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 学习型视觉奖励模型在优化机器人策略时可能放大"错误对象"失败：任务成功率与奖励同时上升，但误作用到错误物体的失败也随之增加，且常规监控指标看似健康。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人策略常以学习型视觉奖励模型(如Robometer)进行优化，但该奖励可能对"作用于错误对象"的执行给出与完成任务同样高的分数，从而在优化过程中被放大，而从业者常规监控的奖励与任务成功率却呈现健康态势。

Method: 在抽屉任务上，对扩散策略的全部去噪器参数用Robometer微调；从无奖励先验的监督策略出发，进行五组训练。对比用模拟器任务完成信号训练的五组。通过更换策略原生扩散采样器、匹配到初始策略的距离、以及两critic两optimizer的受限策略实验检验复现性。提出"倾斜模型"解释：KL正则优化下，只要某结果在初始策略下的期望奖励高于总体均值，其发生频率就会上升。并在26个受限设定上验证该模型的预测。

Result: 用Robometer训练的五组运行在512个评估种子上任务成功率提升10.2个百分点，错误对象失败增加10.9个百分点；用模拟器完成信号训练的五组则只提升成功率而不放大错误对象失败(差异9.2个百分点，95% CI 5.6–13.0)。放大现象在多种条件下复现。Robometer总体区分成败较好(AUROC .81)，但对错误对象失败打分略高于成功(AUROC .37)，故优化同时抬高两者。倾斜模型在26个受限设定中预测结果偏移(Spearman .89)，包括任务成功率下降的情形，且Robometer公开的成功-终止配方继承了该错误。冻结的结果验证器可将同一优化重新导向所请求的任务。

Conclusion: 学习型视觉奖励模型可能在提升任务成功率的同时系统性放大"错误对象"失败，且常规监控信号无法察觉；该现象可由倾斜模型解释并可预测。使用冻结的结果验证器可纠正优化方向。

Abstract: Learned visual reward models are increasingly used to optimize robot policies, yet a reward model can score an execution that acts on the wrong object as highly as one that completes the task. We show that optimizing such a reward can amplify these wrong-object failures while reward and task success both rise, so the signals a practitioner would normally monitor look healthy. We fine-tune every denoiser parameter of a diffusion policy against Robometer on a drawer task. Starting from a supervised policy with no prior reward exposure, five training runs raise task success by 10.2 percentage points and wrong-object failures by 10.9 points on 512 evaluation seeds, whereas five runs trained on the simulator's task-completion signal raise success without amplifying wrong-object failures (difference 9.2 points, 95% CI 5.6 to 13.0). The amplification recurs from a policy previously optimized against learned rewards, under the policy's native diffusion sampler, at matched distance from the initial policy, and across constrained-policy experiments with two critics and two optimizers. A tilt model explains when it occurs: under KL-regularized optimization, an outcome becomes more frequent whenever its expected reward under the initial policy exceeds the population average. Robometer separates successes from failures well overall (AUROC .81) but scores wrong-object failures slightly above successes (AUROC .37), so optimization raises both. The same model predicts the outcome shifts across 26 constrained settings (Spearman .89), including those in which task success falls, and Robometer's own published success-termination recipe inherits the error. A frozen outcome verifier redirects the same optimization toward the requested task.

</details>


### [113] [Real-time Event-camera Stereo Visual Odometry via Keytime Gaussian Process Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02601)
*Nikan Nobari,Jonathan D. Gammell*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出连续时间事件相机双目视觉里程计（VO）管线，利用WNOA先验将估计状态精简至关键时间点、同时把测量插值到精确时间戳，从而在保留异步事件原生时间分辨率的同时实现实时运行；在MVSEC与DSEC上精度与频率均优于ES-PTAM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机具有微秒级时间分辨率与高动态范围，相比传统帧相机更抗运动模糊和弱光。但要充分发挥优势，事件VO必须以原生时间分辨率处理异步事件流。连续时间高斯过程回归与白噪声加速度（WNOA）先验虽能处理异步测量，但直接应用会导致估计状态规模过大、难以实时运行。

Method: 设计连续时间事件相机双目VO管线：将估计状态缩减到关键时间点（keytimes），借助物理建模的WNOA先验把测量插值到其精确时间戳，从而保留完整时间分辨率；由此将状态规模与密集测量数量解耦，同时不丢弃测量的异步特性，实现实时运行。

Result: 在MVSEC和DSEC数据集上评估，实时估计在除一个序列外的所有测试序列中均比当前先进的离散估计器ES-PTAM更准确。管线在MVSEC和DSEC上分别达到22 Hz与6 Hz，所有有效序列的RMS相对误差分别为0.46 cm和0.038度，比ES-PTAM分别好11倍和15倍。

Conclusion: 通过关键时间点状态与WNOA先验插值，连续时间事件相机双目VO可兼顾原生异步时间分辨率与实时性，并在精度和运行频率上超越先进离散方法，验证了该范式的有效性。

Abstract: Event cameras have microsecond-level temporal resolution and high dynamic range which make them more resilient to motion blur and poor illumination than standard frame-based cameras. Event-camera visual odometry (VO) pipelines maximize these benefits when they process the asynchronous event stream at the native temporal resolution. Continuous-time Gaussian process (GP) regression and a white-noise-on-acceleration (WNOA) prior can handle asynchronous measurements but result in a prohibitively large estimation state when applied naively.
  This paper presents a continuous-time event-camera stereo VO pipeline that maintains the native measurement times of asynchronous events while also running in real time. It reduces the estimation states to keytimes while maintaining full temporal resolution by interpolating measurements to their exact timestamps with a physically founded WNOA prior. This decouples the state size from the dense number of measurements without discarding their asynchronous nature.
  The real-time continuous-time VO pipeline is evaluated on the MVSEC and DSEC datasets. It provides estimates in real time that are more accurate than ES-PTAM, a state-of-the-art discrete estimator, in all but one of the tested sequences. The pipeline respectively provides estimates at 22 Hz and 6 Hz on MVSEC and DSEC and RMS relative errors of 0.46 cm and 0.038 degrees across all valid sequences, which were 11 and 15 times better than ES-PTAM, respectively.

</details>


### [114] [A Passive AI System for Verifying Physical State on Automated Liquid Handlers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02668)
*Junqiong Joanne Qiu,Zeckria Kamrany,Ananya Anand,Emma Vidal,Yunjia Johanna Bai,Nathan S Chen,Sean Son,Varada Abhyankar,Taryn Jakub,Eleazar Eskin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出无源视觉系统Labware Setup Checker，通过外部摄像头与独立软件验证Opentrons Flex的甲板准备情况，无需改动硬件或固件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化液体处理器虽能执行数字协议，但操作员仍需手动组装台面并确认物理设置符合实验意图，缺乏自动校验手段。

Method: 在机器人外部安装消费级网络摄像头，浏览器应用对甲板进行槽位分割，利用已知台面几何校正槽位分配，分类耗材，并与参考协议库比对，报告缺失、错放或多余耗材，且独立于机器人控制器运行、不干扰流程。

Result: 在SwabSeq RVP预PCR甲板准备中，系统在机器人运动前29帧全部识别出完整组件；348次分类中95.1%与协议一致；480帧部分遮挡下6,720次槽位分配全部正确；三种摄像头位置与两种光照下槽位分配100%正确，分类匹配率97.73%；笔记本CPU中位验证时间2.10秒，实验室AWS部署从捕获到接收4.24秒。

Conclusion: 外部摄像头与独立软件可在数秒内依据协议验证甲板设置，使操作员在启动运行前即可审查物理设置。

Abstract: Automated liquid handlers execute digital protocols, but operators must assemble the deck and confirm that the physical setup matches the intended experiment. We present the Labware Setup Checker, a passive vision system that verifies deck preparation on an Opentrons Flex without modifying its hardware or firmware. A consumer webcam mounted outside the robot supplies images to a browser application. The checker segments the deck into slots, corrects slot assignments using the known deck geometry, classifies the labware, and compares the observed setup with a reference protocol library to report missing, misplaced, or unexpected labware. It operates independently of the robot controller and does not interrupt or gate a run. During SwabSeq Respiratory Viral Panel (RVP) pre-PCR deck preparation, the checker tracked a slot from empty to a base and then to the completed plate-and-base assembly, identifying the completed assembly in all 29 frames before robot motion. Across these frames, 95.1% of the 348 labware classifications for slots requiring exact matches agreed with the protocol reference. In 480 frames with partially occluded reservoirs, all 6,720 slot assignments were correct. Across three camera positions and two lighting conditions, slot assignment was 100% correct, and 97.73% of labware classifications matched the protocol reference. Median verification time was 2.10 s on a laptop using only its CPU and 4.24 s from frame capture to receipt of results during AWS deployment in the laboratory. These results show that an external camera and independent software can provide verification of deck setup against protocol requirements within seconds, allowing operators to review the physical setup before starting a run.

</details>


### [115] [DeltaWorld: Physically Consistent Interactive World Simulators via Action-Conditioned Latent Increment Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02691)
*Boyuan Hou,Xiaoge Cao,Chaofan Zhang,Shuo Wang,Shaowei Cui*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出DeltaWorld，一种物理一致的交互式世界模拟器，通过预测动作引起的潜在变化而非直接预测下一状态，改善机器人操作中的长时程动作条件视频预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式世界模拟器可为机器人规划、策略训练与评估提供可扩展环境，减少对物理试验的依赖。但现有世界模型通常直接预测整个下一潜在状态，难以捕捉机器人动作引起的细微变化，导致物体穿插、过度变形等物理不合理结果。

Method: 提出DeltaWorld，包含Delta Latent Transition Model（Delta-LTM），预测动作引起的潜在特征变化并叠加到当前潜在状态得到下一状态；并引入Interaction-aware Latent Alignment，构建反事实交互区域以监督交互相关的潜在变化。

Result: 在IWS操作基准和自采集的跨机器人数据集（涵盖多种机器人本体与操作任务）上评估。在跨机器人数据集上，相较IWS基线，FVD降低46.6%，LPIPS降低31.1%。

Conclusion: 结果表明DeltaWorld在机器人操作的长时程动作条件视频预测方面具有潜力。

Abstract: Interactive world simulators can provide scalable environments for robot planning, policy training, and evaluation by predicting action consequences while reducing reliance on repeated physical rollouts. To serve these applications, they must generate future image sequences that respond faithfully to robot actions and preserve the dynamics of robot-object interactions over long horizons. However, existing world models typically predict the entire next latent state and often fail to capture subtle changes induced by robot actions. Such omissions can produce physically implausible outcomes, including object interpenetration and excessive deformation. To address this limitation, we propose DeltaWorld, a physically consistent interactive world simulator for robotic manipulation. Our method introduces the Delta Latent Transition Model (Delta-LTM), which predicts action-induced latent feature changes and adds them to the current latent state to obtain the next state, rather than predicting the next latent state directly. To mitigate object interpenetration and excessive deformation in predicted future frames, Interaction-aware Latent Alignment is introduced to construct counterfactual interaction regions and supervise interaction-related latent changes. DeltaWorld is evaluated on the IWS manipulation benchmark and a self-collected cross-robot dataset covering multiple robot embodiments and manipulation tasks. On the cross-robot dataset, DeltaWorld reduces FVD by 46.6% and LPIPS by 31.1% relative to the IWS baseline. These results highlight the potential of DeltaWorld for long-horizon action-conditioned video prediction in robotic manipulation.

</details>


### [116] [Who Went Where When on the Lunar Surface: Forensic Trajectory Analysis to Identify Byzantine Rovers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02694)
*Lachlan Holden,Feras Dayoub,Melissa de Zwart,David Harvey,Tat-Jun Chin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出面向非合作行星漫游车的"取证轨迹分析"问题：在多车共享部署区、仅有稀疏遥测（里程计、位姿先验、车间相对检测）的条件下，重建漫游车轨迹以核查安全区合规性；并针对提供篡改或伪造测量的拜占庭漫游车，提出以"漫游车可信度"而非"单条测量有效性"为核心的归因感知轨迹估计方法，性能优于现有鲁棒位姿图优化基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 未来行星表面任务中，多台独立运行的漫游车可能共享同一部署区域，需要事后核查其是否遵守月球安全区等运行约束。然而连续原位观测通常不可得，只能依赖稀疏遥测做事后轨迹重建。更棘手的是，部分漫游车可能是"拜占庭"节点，通过错误标定或故意伪造测量来支撑一条错误轨迹；此时传统抗离群点的位姿图优化会失效，因为伪造测量可以自洽且数量占优，反而把真实的、具有"定罪"作用的测量挤成离群点。

Method: 作者将该问题形式化为"非合作行星漫游车在拜占庭智能体存在下的取证轨迹分析"。提出归因感知（attribution-aware）的轨迹估计方法：不判断单条测量是否有效，而是推断漫游车的可信度。具体做法是枚举候选的可信漫游车子集，将其内部相对检测与边界相对检测的统计一致性与给定先验进行比较来评估可信度，最后仅使用归属于可信智能体的测量进行轨迹估计。

Result: 在合成仿真数据与真实行星模拟环境轨迹数据上，所提方法能够识别出拜占庭漫游车，并且生成的轨迹估计精度显著优于现有鲁棒位姿图优化基线方法。

Conclusion: 研究表明，在多智能体、非合作且存在恶意或失准节点的行星探测场景中，从"测量级鲁棒性"转向"智能体级可信度归因"是必要的；该归因感知框架可有效识别拜占庭漫游车并提升事后轨迹重建精度，为安全区合规性取证提供可行途径。

Abstract: Future planetary surface missions are likely to involve multiple independently operated rovers sharing the same deployment region, raising the need to verify compliance with operational constraints such as Lunar Safety Zones. Because continuous in-situ observability is rarely available, such verification requires post-hoc reconstruction of rover trajectories from sparse telemetry, including odometry, pose priors, and relative inter-rover detections. We introduce the problem of forensic trajectory analysis for non-cooperative planetary rovers in the presence of Byzantine agents: rovers that provide miscalibrated or deliberately falsified measurements to support an incorrect trajectory. We show that standard outlier-robust pose graph optimisation methods are vulnerable in this setting, because Byzantine rovers can generate measurements that are internally consistent and numerous enough to make truthful incriminating measurements appear as outliers. To address this, we propose an attribution-aware trajectory estimation method that reasons over rover credibility rather than individual measurement validity. The method evaluates candidate credible rover subsets by comparing the statistical consistency of their internal and boundary relative detections against provided priors, and then estimates trajectories using only measurements attributed to credible agents. Across synthetic simulations and real planetary-analogue trajectory data, the proposed method identifies Byzantine rovers and produces significantly more accurate trajectory estimates than existing robust pose graph optimisation baselines.

</details>


### [117] [GeoScaffold: Learning Compact Geometric Latents via Reconstruction for Efficient Vision-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02697)
*Yixuan Jiang,Wentong Li,An Liu,Zihao Xin,Fulin Tang,Cong Leng,Yang Gao,Jian Cheng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出GeoScaffold，一种在训练阶段一次性注入几何监督的框架，将3D几何先验内化到策略中，推理时不增加额外开销，在连续VLN基准上超越纯视觉导航器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式Video-LLM导航策略将自我中心RGB观测与指令直接映射为低层动作，但继承了2D预训练中较弱的3D几何先验。现有几何感知扩展需付出持续的推理代价（深度传感器、3D编码器或逐步感知工具调用）。

Method: 先在训练轨迹的深度图上学习一个紧凑的深度tokenizer并冻结；再用少量可学习的几何查询token微调策略，训练其隐藏状态重建导航关键几何（深度、连通性、可通行性）。该监督使查询状态成为动作解码的紧凑几何隐变量，并通过共享权重将几何内化到骨干表示中。

Result: 大量实验表明，GeoScaffold在连续VLN基准上持续优于领先的纯视觉导航器。

Conclusion: GeoScaffold如脚手架一般，训练后丢弃tokenizer、目标生成器和重建头，骨干与动作接口保持不变，为空间感知具身导航模型的轻量化边缘部署提供了实用范式。

Abstract: Recent vision-and-language navigation (VLN) systems increasingly adopt streaming Video-LLM policies that map egocentric RGB observations and instructions directly to low-level actions. Yet these policies inherit weak 3D geometric priors from 2D pretraining. Existing geometry-aware extensions charge a persistent inference-time price: depth sensors, 3D encoders, or per-step perception tool calls. We propose GeoScaffold, a geometric supervision framework that pays this price once, at training time, by internalizing geometry into the policy itself. It first learns a compact depth tokenizer on depth maps from the training trajectories and freezes it. It then fine-tunes the policy with a handful of learnable geometry query tokens, training their hidden states to reconstruct navigation-critical geometry such as depth, connectivity, and traversability. This supervision turns the query states into compact geometric latents for action decoding, and through the shared weights also internalizes geometry into the backbone's own representations. Like a scaffold, the tokenizer, target generators, and reconstruction heads are discarded after training, leaving the backbone and action interface unchanged. Extensive experiments show that GeoScaffold consistently outperforms leading vision-only navigators on continuous VLN benchmarks, offering a practical paradigm for lightweight edge deployment of spatially aware embodied navigation models.

</details>


### [118] [AdaTempo: Learning Shared Relative Tempo from Demonstrations for Faster Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02706)
*Jiale Cao,Yike Niu,Zhengrong Xue,Huazhe Xu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 AdaTempo，一种自监督方法，通过挖掘演示中的共享相对节奏结构来加速视觉运动策略，最高实现 3.57 倍加速且优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模仿学习训练的视觉运动策略继承了遥操作演示中不必要的慢节奏，而均匀加速不可靠，因为操作任务的不同阶段对加速的容忍度不同。

Method: AdaTempo 建立阶段对应关系，将对齐后的相对节奏聚合成共识，再映射为连续加速曲线，用其重采样演示为加速训练轨迹；在重采样轨迹上训练 ACT 或 Diffusion Policy，将目标节奏直接嵌入学习行为，无需运行时节奏选择或在线重定时。

Result: 大量评估显示 AdaTempo 最高实现 3.57 倍加速，并在成功率与速度的权衡上优于原始策略与代表性加速基线。

Conclusion: 通过自监督挖掘演示中的相对节奏结构并重采样轨迹，AdaTempo 能在不引入运行时开销的情况下有效加速视觉运动策略。

Abstract: Visuomotor policies trained via imitation learning often inherit the unnecessarily slow timing of teleoperated demonstrations. Yet uniform speedup is unreliable because different phases of a manipulation task tolerate acceleration differently. In this work, we introduce AdaTempo, a self-supervised method that accelerates visuomotor policies by exploiting shared relative-tempo structure in demonstrations. AdaTempo establishes phase correspondence, aggregates the aligned relative tempo into a consensus, and maps it to a continuous speedup profile used to resample demonstrations into accelerated training trajectories. Training standard policies such as ACT or Diffusion Policy on these resampled trajectories directly embeds the desired tempo in the learned behavior, without runtime tempo selection or online retiming. Extensive evaluations show that AdaTempo achieves up to a $3.57\times$ speedup and yields a stronger success--speed trade-off than the original policies and representative acceleration baselines.

</details>


### [119] [RoboChemGym: A Protocol-Driven Generative Simulation Framework for Long-Horizon Chemical Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02708)
*Chenxi Li,Haiyuan Wan,Rui Li,Jingyuan Li,Sha Zhang,Bohan Feng,Jianbao Cao,Zhangrui Zhao,Di Hu,Wangmeng Zuo,Shixiang Tang,Minting Pan,Dongzhan Zhou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 RoboChemGym，一个为化学实验具身智能体自动生成高保真操作演示的框架，并配套分层基准评测体系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 湿实验是科学假设验证的金标准，但耗时、昂贵且有安全风险。具身智能体有望自动化这些流程，但真实训练数据稀缺。现有仿真方法多针对短时程、弱结构交互任务，难以满足化学实验严格的程序约束和细粒度操作需求。

Method: 提出 RoboChemGym 框架，能够按照真实实验协议自主生成高保真操作演示。核心是自改进任务合成机制，迭代优化任务执行与场景配置，从而为超过 10 个交互步骤的复杂多物体协议可靠生成专家轨迹。同时构建分层基准，从原子操作到全周期实验工作流进行不同粒度的系统评估。

Result: 能够可靠生成超过 10 交互步骤的复杂多物体实验协议的高质量专家轨迹，并通过分层基准实现对从原子操作到完整实验流程的多粒度性能评估。

Conclusion: RoboChemGym 为化学任务中具身智能体的自动化数据合成与能力评估提供了可扩展范式，是迈向全智能实验室的重要一步。

Abstract: Wet-lab experimentation serves as the gold standard for hypothesis verification in scientific discovery; yet it is inherently labor-intensive, costly, and safety-critical. Embodied agents hold the promise of automating these tedious workflows, but their development is hindered by the scarcity of real-world training data. While simulation offers a scalable alternative for producing demonstrations, current methods primarily target relatively short-horizon tasks with loosely structured interactions, failing to meet the strict procedural constraints and fine-grained manipulation demands of chemical experiments. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{RoboChemGym}, a framework that autonomously generates high-fidelity manipulation demonstrations aligned with real-world experiment protocols, featuring a \textit{self-improving task synthesis} mechanism to iteratively refine task execution and scene configurations, enabling the reliable generation of expert trajectories for complex, multi-object protocols exceeding 10 interaction steps. Furthermore, we introduce a hierarchical benchmark that systematically assesses performance across varying granularities, spanning from atomic operations to full-cycle experimental workflows. RoboChemGym sets a scalable paradigm for the automated data synthesis and capability evaluation of embodied agents in intricate chemical tasks, serving as a critical stepping stone toward fully intelligent laboratories.

</details>


### [120] [RoboBridge: A Self-Evolving Embodied Agent Framework for Sim-to-Real Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02717)
*Chenxi Li,Zhangrui Zhao,Rui Li,Yuan Gao,Kehui Liu,Jiarui Li,Dong Wang,Tong Si,Minting Pan,Wanli Ouyang,Dongzhan Zhou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 RoboBridge 框架，将仿真到现实（sim-to-real）迁移视为可执行任务技能的持续适应过程，通过程序化任务知识表示与交互反馈驱动的技能修订实现跨环境持续学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略虽具备强操作能力，但其迁移到物理环境通常依赖校准仿真视觉与动力学条件、采集目标域演示并继续训练；而现有工具使用型具身智能体侧重单环境内任务执行与经验复用，缺乏跨仿真与现实迁移程序化知识并持续适应的能力。

Method: RoboBridge 将任务知识表示为连接任务意图、观测、工具操作与结果验证的程序（procedures）；利用交互反馈生成候选技能修订，经评估后决定持久化或拒绝；将预训练 VLA 策略封装为可复用动作工具，并加入推理时引导以实现细粒度执行，无需重训底层策略；把可迁移技能锚定在仿真与现实共享的任务语义与交互接口上，使环境相关操作可依据真实执行反馈选择性修订。

Result: 在 LIBERO-PRO 及对应的物理任务上进行评估，研究技能演化与迁移后适应两方面表现。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了一条从一次性策略部署走向跨环境持续程序化学习的路径。

Abstract: A key challenge in bringing embodied intelligence into the real world is transferring capabilities from simulation to reality and enabling agents to continually adapt after deployment. End-to-end vision-language-action policies provide strong manipulation capabilities, but their transfer to physical environments typically relies on calibrating simulated visual and dynamical conditions, collecting additional target-domain demonstrations, and optimizing the policy through further training. Tool-using embodied agents offer flexible task orchestration, yet existing systems primarily emphasize task execution and experience reuse within a given environment, with limited support for transferring procedural knowledge and continuously adapting it across simulation and reality. We propose RoboBridge, a framework that treats sim-to-real transfer as the continued adaptation of executable task skills. The agent represents task knowledge as procedures connecting task intent, observations, tool operations, and outcome verification. Interaction feedback is used to generate candidate skill revisions, which are evaluated before being persisted or rejected. A pretrained vision-language-action policy is exposed as a reusable action tool and enhanced with inference-time guidance, enabling fine-grained execution without retraining the underlying policy. RoboBridge grounds transferable skills in task semantics and interaction interfaces shared across simulation and reality. This representation preserves reusable task structure while allowing environment-dependent operations to be selectively revised through real-world execution feedback. We evaluate the framework on LIBERO-PRO and corresponding physical tasks, studying both skill evolution and post-transfer adaptation. Our framework provides a route from one-shot policy deployment to continual procedural learning across environments.

</details>


### [121] [Around the World: Unified Learned Locomotion on a 270 g Continuous-Rotation Quadruped](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02728)
*Arturo Flores Alvarez,Nathan Lintu,Dennis Hong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出MiNI-Q，一个270克的小型四足机器人，利用连续旋转腿部实现身体两侧的支撑，用单一姿态条件强化学习策略在机载完成正立行走、倒立行走与落地恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 闭环学习运动在商用四足机器人上已成熟，但在亚千克级小型平台上仍少见；作者希望利用连续旋转腿部带来的多样支撑构型，扩展小型四足的运动能力。

Method: 将连续关节空间参考建模在环面T^8上，并做重力条件变换，连接正立行走、倒立行走与落地恢复，无需状态机或相位切换；采用协调姿态与释放课程训练，并进行驱动辨识、跨引擎验证与嵌入式部署，使用参数量低于100k的单一网络。

Result: 同一网络跟踪前向速度的RMSE在正立时为0.037 m/s、倒立时为0.050 m/s；30次释放试验中24次恢复行走；可在四种可互换足部几何与四种室内地面上运行。

Conclusion: 硬件实验与仿真消融表明，这些能力来自对平台运动范围的表示、条件化与训练选择的有效利用。

Abstract: Closed-loop learned locomotion is established on commercial quadrupeds but remains uncommon at the sub-kilogram scale. Continuous-rotation legs give MiNI-Q, a 270 g quadruped, access to supporting configurations on either side of the body. We exploit this range with a single posture-conditioned reinforcement-learning policy that runs entirely onboard. A continuous joint-space reference on the torus $T^8$ and its gravity-conditioned transformation connect upright walking, inverted walking, and landing recovery without state machines or phase switching. Coordinated posture and release curricula train this behavior family; identified actuation, cross-engine validation, and embedded execution support hardware transfer. The same sub-100k-parameter network tracks forward velocity with RMSE of 0.037 m/s upright and 0.050 m/s inverted, resumes walking in 24 of 30 release trials, and operates with four interchangeable foot geometries across four indoor surfaces. Hardware experiments and simulation ablations connect these capabilities to the representation, conditioning, and training choices that exploit the platform's motion range. Demonstration videos and supplementary material are available on the project website: https://submissionreview.github.io/around-the-world/.

</details>


### [122] [CSIR: Contextually and Socially Informed Robots for Efficient Person Goal Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02750)
*Tyler Chung,Nahl Farhan,Hao Zhang,Mingfeng Yuan,Jinjun Shan,Amy Wu,Yue Hu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出PersonNav（人物目标导航）问题，让机器人在信息可及性受限和语言不确定的真实约束下寻找人物。作者提出一个融合距离与语义信息（习惯与意图）并以用户信息可信度加权的规划框架，配合合成基准测试，实验显示其优于经典距离图基线，并支持真实硬件部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的人物寻找系统往往依赖对目标个体的精确知识，且受限于隐私导致数据不可用或稀疏，难以在真实室内场景中灵活地进行物品递送等任务。因此需要一种能在信息受限与语言不确定下工作、更接近人类智能搜寻方式的机器人导航方案。

Method: 提出一个规划框架，融合目标接收者的距离信息与语义信息（习惯、意图），并用用户提供信息的可信度进行加权；同时构建包含角色、物品与请求的合成场景基准，以模拟自然语言人机交互并用于真实部署前评估；另有一个基于大语言模型的变体。

Result: 知情搜索方法优于经典的距离图基线；仅使用语义会导致无根据、零散的搜索；方法相对基线取得显著提升，基于LLM的变体表现相当；显式的信念表示天然支持未来的贝叶斯滤波；硬件测试表明方法可在真实环境中利用语义与距离信息。

Conclusion: 该工作推动了更智能的移动服务智能体发展，使其具备类人的知情搜索能力，可在真实环境中用于日常使用。

Abstract: We address the Person Goal Navigation (PersonNav) problem, enabling robots to search for people under realistic constraints on information accessibility and language uncertainty. This tackles the current solutions revolving around rigid person finding systems requiring exact knowledge of the individual for item-delivery in indoor settings. While the focus in literature is on learned methods using unavailable public or sparse data due to human privacy. We propose a planning framework that combines distance and semantic information about the recipient (habits and intent) weighted by the trust of the user-provided information. A synthetic benchmark of scenarios is also developed including actors, items, and requests to evaluate performance before real-world deployment aiming to simulate natural language human-robot interactions. Results show our informed search outperforms classical distance-based graph baselines, while semantics alone lead to ungrounded, sporadic search. Our method achieves strong gains over baselines, with an LLM-based variant performing comparably, and its explicit belief representation naturally supports future Bayesian filtering. Hardware tests demonstrate our method supports real-world embodiment able to leverage between semantic and distance information in a real setting. This work moves toward more intelligent mobile service agents capable of human-like, informed search in realistic environments to be leveraged in day-to-day use. https://anonymous.4open.science/r/personnavsite-4ED2/index.html.

</details>


### [123] [Proprioceptive Sketches as Long-Horizon Intent for Generative Action Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02759)
*Fangyuan Wang,Songhao Huang,Haoxiang Sun,Shipeng Lyu,Chengyang He,Anqing Duan,Peng Zhou,David Navarro-Alarcon*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PAM 通过在一个 transformer 去噪器中联合生成"无时间索引的关节空间轨迹草图"与"稠密可执行动作块"，以低成本捕捉长时程几何意图并提升机器人策略性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式机器人策略只预测短动作块，缺乏显式长时程意图；而语言规划、子目标图像或视频预测等长时程表示生成成本高且需额外翻译为动作。直接预测未来机器人运动可免去翻译，但稠密时间索引轨迹参数量大，且短时程内基本重复动作块、对动作生成指导有限。

Method: 提出 Proprioceptive Action Models (PAM)：在单一 transformer 去噪器中联合生成紧凑的、无时间索引的机器人剩余关节空间路径草图与稠密可执行动作块。草图以弧长而非时间参数化路径，捕捉对执行时序不变的几何意图；并使用块因果注意力与交错去噪调度，保持草图到动作的有向依赖，使动作 token 在采样过程中持续以逐步变清晰的草图为条件。

Result: 仿真中，PAM 在 Push-T 与 LIBERO-Long 上优于仅用动作的对应方法；在四个真实双臂任务上，成功率由 47.5% 提升至 75.0%。

Conclusion: 以弧长参数化的无时间草图作为长时程几何意图表示，并与动作块联合去噪生成，可在不增加高成本中间表示的前提下有效提升机器人策略的长时程执行能力。

Abstract: Generative robot policies predict short action chunks but lack explicit long-horizon intent. Recent methods expose longer-horizon structure through language plans, subgoal images, or video forecasts, which are costly to generate and still need to be translated into robot motion. Predicting future robot motions avoids this translation, but a dense, time-indexed trajectory requires numerous parameters to cover the full remaining task, and over a short horizon it largely repeats the action chunk and adds little guidance for action generation. We propose Proprioceptive Action Models (PAM), which jointly generate a compact, timing-free sketch of the robot's remaining joint-space path and a dense executable action chunk within a single transformer denoiser. The sketch parameterizes the path by arc length rather than time, capturing geometric intent invariant to execution timing. Block-causal attention and a staggered denoising schedule maintain directed sketch-to-action dependence, ensuring the action tokens condition on a progressively cleaner sketch throughout sampling. In simulation, PAM improves over its action-only counterparts on Push-T and LIBERO-Long; on four real-world bimanual tasks, it raises success from 47.5% to 75.0%. Project page: https://nicehiro.github.io/pam_dp/

</details>


### [124] [Localized Conformal Safety Monitoring with Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02765)
*Luís Marques,Rong Fang,Disha Kamale,Dmitry Berenson*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出SLLCP方法，对冻结的视觉语言模型进行事后校准，将不可靠预测转化为概率校准的安全预测集，用于自动驾驶碰撞风险评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 监测规划驾驶轨迹需准确估计与受自车运动影响的行为体发生碰撞的可能性。现有经典方法受限于预测模型质量；视觉语言模型虽能推理高层动作后果，但其近似预测不适合自动驾驶等安全关键应用。因此需要量化黑盒模型预测不确定性的方法。

Method: 提出Split Label-Localized Conformal Prediction (SLLCP)，作为冻结VLM之上的事后校准层。考虑安全估计能力可能依赖于观测到的驾驶场景，引入局部化程序，在计算不确定性阈值时提高相关历史经验的权重。在可交换性假设下提供标签条件有限样本无分布覆盖保证。

Result: 在15k条来自未见场景的CARLA轨迹上评估：SLLCP使用Qwen骨干正确标记89.6%的致碰撞轨迹，使用Cosmos骨干为88.4%；而基座VLM仅分别标记4.6%和39.1%的致碰撞轨迹。

Conclusion: 结果表明，局部、标签条件的校准可以减少漏检的不安全轨迹，提升自动驾驶安全预测的可靠性。

Abstract: Monitoring planned driving trajectories requires accurately estimating the collision likelihood with actors whose motion is itself impacted by the ego motion. Existing classical approaches are often limited by the quality of their forecasting model. Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown promise in reasoning about the consequences of high-level actions, yet their approximate predictions are unsuitable for safety-critical applications such as autonomous driving. Conformal prediction (CP) has emerged as a data-driven framework for quantifying the uncertainty of black-box model predictions. We propose Split Label-Localized Conformal Prediction (SLLCP), a post-hoc calibration layer over frozen VLMs that transforms their unreliable predictions into probabilistically calibrated safety prediction sets. We consider how the ability to estimate safety can depend on the observed driving scene and introduce a localized procedure that upweights relevant past experience when calculating uncertainty thresholds. We provide label-conditional finite-sample distribution-free coverage under exchangeability. Evaluated over 15k CARLA trajectories from unseen scenarios, SLLCP correctly flags 89.6% of collision-causing trajectories with a Qwen backbone and 88.4% with a Cosmos backbone, while the base VLMs only flagged 4.6% and 39.1% of the collision-causing trajectories, respectively. These results indicate that local, label-conditional calibration can reduce missed unsafe trajectories.

</details>


### [125] [SimpleTouch: Can Vision-Language-Action Models Master Contact-Rich Manipulation Without Tactile Policy Pretraining?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02784)
*Chen Yang,Linzhe Shi,Changjie Wu,Hang Zhang,Ronghan Chen,Lingjun Zhang,Xu Hu,Mu Xu,Jiansheng Fan,Chen Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SimpleTouch 通过在 π0.5 的 VLA 模型中添加触觉专家，仅用任务演示进行单阶段训练，无需触觉策略预训练或独立对齐，即在多种任务上取得领先成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将触觉引入预训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型存在困难：仅靠任务微调引入触觉可能无法弥合跨模态差距，收益有限甚至降低成功率；现有方法依赖大规模触觉策略预训练或独立的视触觉对齐，增加了数据需求和训练阶段。

Method: 提出 SimpleTouch，一种简单的 VLA 扩展：在 π0.5 上增加一个触觉专家，使用冻结的预训练触觉编码器的全部 token，通过动作监督与未来触觉潜变量的多步预测进行学习；单阶段训练，仅使用任务演示，无需额外触觉策略预训练或独立对齐。

Result: 每任务 50 条演示下，在六个 UniVTAC 任务中成功率均最高，平均 77.5%，对比 FTP-π0.5 的 45.2% 和 FTP-1 的 66.7%，分别提升 32.3 和 10.8 个百分点；在四个真实任务上平均 71.3%，超过 FTP-1 达 8.8 个百分点。

Conclusion: 在已具备预训练 VLA 与触觉表征的前提下，额外的触觉策略预训练并非强性能的前提条件，为接触丰富型操作提供了一条更简洁的路径。

Abstract: Tactile sensing provides essential contact information for robotic manipulation, yet incorporating it into pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models remains challenging. A common concern is that simply introducing touch during task-specific fine-tuning may fail to bridge the cross-modal gap, yielding limited gains or even reduced success. Consequently, existing methods often rely on large-scale tactile policy pretraining or separate visuotactile alignment, adding data requirements and training stages. We introduce SimpleTouch, a simple VLA extension that augments $π_{0.5}$ with a tactile expert, to test whether these additional stages are necessary. Leveraging all tokens from a frozen pretrained tactile encoder, the expert learns from action supervision and multi-horizon prediction of future tactile latents. This single-stage training uses only task demonstrations, without additional tactile policy pretraining or separate alignment. With 50 demonstrations per task, SimpleTouch achieves the highest success rate among evaluated methods on all six UniVTAC tasks. Its average success rate reaches 77.5%, compared with 45.2% for FTP-$π_{0.5}$ and 66.7% for FTP-1, corresponding to gains of 32.3 and 10.8 percentage points, respectively. Across four real-world tasks, it averages 71.3%, exceeding FTP-1 by 8.8 percentage points. These results demonstrate that, given pretrained VLA and tactile representations, additional tactile policy pretraining is not a prerequisite for strong performance on these tasks, offering a simpler route to contact-rich manipulation. Project page: https://simpletouch-robot.github.io/

</details>


### [126] [Skill2Real: Agentic Skill Learning for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02788)
*Xincheng He,Siyu Ma,Chang Yu,Yunuo Chen,Yanjia Huang,Ying Nian Wu,Yin Yang,Chenfanfu Jiang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 Skill2Real 智能体策略框架，通过共享 API 学习可执行技能，并借助 Proposer-Verifier-Governor 循环将仿真技能迁移至真机。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人技能从仿真迁移到现实，需要能跨越感知、动力学与本体差异仍可使用的任务知识，为此需要一种基于通用接口的技能学习与迁移方式。

Method: 采用 Proposer-Verifier-Governor（PVG）循环，利用仿真特权证据诊断结果并验证更新，同时使技能扎根于公开观测与 API 语义；Cerebellum 先学习局部操作技能，Brain 在 Cerebellum 冻结下学习任务级组合，两个记忆无需任务策略微调或技能记忆更新即可迁移到真机。

Result: 在 LIBERO-90 上学习技能后，冻结检查点在 LIBERO-Pro Long 上成功率从 2.0% 提升到 56.3%（未在 Pro Long 上训练）；独立 Robosuite 训练在七个任务上分别达到 85.1% 和 89.4% 平均成功率；冻结的 Sol 训练 LIBERO-90 技能在四个真实操作任务上达到 78.75% 平均完成率；去掉 Verifier 或 Governor 分别使 Pro Long 最终成功率下降 17.3 和 13.3 个百分点。

Conclusion: 结果表明，通过通用机器人接口可以学习并迁移可执行技能层级，验证了该框架在仿真到现实迁移中的有效性。

Abstract: Transferring robotic skills from simulation to reality requires task knowledge that remains usable across differences in perception, dynamics, and embodiment. We introduce Skill2Real, an agentic policy framework that learns executable skills through a shared application programming interface (API). A Proposer-Verifier-Governor (PVG) loop uses privileged simulation evidence to diagnose outcomes and validate updates, while keeping learned skills grounded in public observations and API semantics. The Cerebellum first acquires local manipulation skills; the Brain then learns task-level composition with the Cerebellum frozen. Both memories transfer to the real robot without task-policy fine-tuning or skill-memory updates. As GPT-5.6 Sol learns skills on LIBERO-90, evaluating each frozen checkpoint with GPT-6 Astra raises LIBERO-Pro Long success from 2.0% to 56.3%, without training on Pro Long. Independent Robosuite training reaches 85.1% and 89.4% mean success with Sol and Opus 5 across seven tasks, respectively. Frozen Sol-trained LIBERO-90 skills achieve 78.75% mean completion across four real-world manipulation tasks with Astra. Removing the Verifier or Governor during LIBERO-90 training lowers final Pro Long success by 17.3 and 13.3 percentage points, respectively. These results support learning and transferring a hierarchy of executable skills through a common robot interface.

</details>


### [127] [ManiPhysicsBench: Physics-Based Assessment of Object Preservation in VLA Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02802)
*Sangwu Park,Yeonjun In,Wonjoong Kim,Sungwon Kim,Sein Kim,Chanyoung Park*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出ManiPhysicsZoo物体资产库与ManiPhysicsBench基准，评估视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在操作任务中是否保持物体完好，发现任务成功率与安全成功率存在显著差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有刚性体基准中的任务成功率无法反映VLA模型是否在操作过程中保持物体（不造成形变或断裂），缺乏对物体保持能力的系统评估手段。

Method: 整合文献支持的材质属性、3D网格与参考文献构建可复用物体资产库ManiPhysicsZoo；基于求解器计算抓取特定的损伤阈值（由几何、材质及记录的抓取条件得出），并与记录的接触力比较以评估潜在形变与断裂；据此在LIBERO和SimplerEnv上构建ManiPhysicsBench，涵盖三个物理轴与三个难度等级，并重新训练VLA模型以检验物体特定的连续夹爪标签的影响。

Result: 公开VLA检查点在任务成功率与安全成功率（在保持物体完好的前提下完成任务）之间存在显著差距；其夹爪指令集中于接近全开与全闭，且不同物体的整体分布相似，与二元夹爪监督一致。重新训练的模型表现出更强的物体相关抓取行为与更高的安全成功率，但任务成功率下降，且物体保持行为的泛化能力有限。

Conclusion: 仅凭任务成功率不足以衡量VLA模型的操作可靠性，物体保持能力应纳入评估；引入物理属性感知的评估基准可揭示现有模型的不足，而连续夹爪监督虽能改善安全性，但以任务成功率和泛化性为代价。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models aim to perform diverse manipulation tasks, but task success in existing rigid-body benchmarks does not indicate whether they preserve objects. We introduce ManiPhysicsZoo, which consolidates literature-supported material properties, 3D meshes, and supporting references into reusable object assets. Using these assets, a solver-based assessment computes grasp-specific damage thresholds from object geometry, material properties, and recorded grasp conditions and compares them with recorded contact forces to assess potential deformation and fracture. Building on these components, ManiPhysicsBench evaluates object preservation in LIBERO and SimplerEnv across three physics axes and three difficulty levels. Public VLA checkpoints show a substantial gap between task success and safe success, defined as task completion while preserving the object. Their gripper commands concentrate near full opening and closure, with largely similar aggregate distributions across objects, consistent with binary gripper supervision. We examine how object-specific continuous gripper labels change model behavior by retraining a VLA model. The retrained model shows more object-dependent gripping and higher safe success, but lower task success and limited generalization of object-preserving behavior.

</details>


### [128] [LOCUS: Landmark-Oriented Container Discrimination Using Spatial Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02803)
*Taylor Bergeron,Shibani Senthilbabu,Kevin Leahy*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 LOCUS 方法，通过在全场景图上训练 GNN 来更新 CLIP 嵌入，结合空间邻近信息与家庭本体语义知识，提升机器人在复杂环境中寻找隐蔽目标物体的推理能力，并在仿真与真实移动操作平台上验证其优于多种基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人在非结构化真实环境中部署时，需要对物体间复杂的空间与语义关系进行推理，才能实现可靠的抓取与导航。典型问题是：当目标物体不在视线内时，判断该去哪里寻找，既取决于物理上的合理性，也取决于语义上的可能性。而 CLIP 余弦相似度等流行方法难以区分空间和语义上都相似、可能容纳目标的物体，因此需要一种能联合推理空间与语义信息的方法。

Method: 作者提出 LOCUS（Landmark-Oriented Container Discrimination Using Spatial Graphs）。方法在完整的环境场景图上训练一个 GNN，通过基于邻近性在节点间传递嵌入信息，从而更新 CLIP 嵌入，实现对空间信息与语义的联合推理。同时将 CLIP 嵌入与家庭本体（household ontologies）融合得到的语义知识相结合，提供稳健的语义信号。仿真评估使用来自模拟器元数据的无噪声场景图，使方法不依赖检测误差。

Result: 在仿真中，LOCUS 在大多数房间类别和配置下均优于随机方法、CLIP、Tidybot 以及一个 LLM 规划器。为验证方法对场景图节点位置和标签噪声的鲁棒性，作者还展示了在物理移动操作机器人上运行的完整探索流程，其中包括来自 Detic 的场景图标签。

Conclusion: LOCUS 通过在图结构上传播并更新 CLIP 嵌入，有效融合空间关系与语义先验，显著提升了机器人在室内环境中寻找容器与目标物体的推理能力。仿真与真实机器人实验表明该方法具有较强泛化性与鲁棒性，且不依赖特定检测器，适合集成到实际探索与操作流程中。

Abstract: As robots are increasingly deployed in unstructured, real-world environments, the ability to reason about complex spatial and semantic relationships among objects remains a fundamental challenge in enabling robust and generalizable manipulation and navigation. For example, deciding where to search for an object that is not in plain sight depends on where it is physically plausible as well as semantically likely. Popular methods such as cosine similarity with CLIP struggle to disambiguate between spatially and semantically similar objects that could contain a target object. We propose Landmark-Oriented Container Discrimination Using Spatial Graphs (LOCUS). To jointly reason about spatial information and semantics, we train a GNN to update CLIP embeddings on a full environment scene graph by passing embedding information between nodes based on proximity. CLIP embeddings, augmented by semantic knowledge from a fusion of household ontologies provide a robust semantic signal. We evaluate in simulation on a noiseless scene graph from simulator metadata, making the approach detection-agnostic. Our approach outperforms random, CLIP, Tidybot, and an LLM planner in the majority of room classes and configurations in simulation. To show our approach is robust to scene graph node placement and label noise, we demonstrate a physical mobile manipulator running in an exploration pipeline start-to-finish including scene graph labels from Detic.

</details>


### [129] [SARI: Phase-Split Sim-Real Co-Training for Contact-Rich Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02804)
*Xingxin He,Yuxuan Jiang,Haonan Zhang,Chuhan Cui,Kaile Li,Zhongxing Zheng,Caihao Xu,Ziqi Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出SARI：按阶段拆分仿真与真实数据的协同训练框架，用仿真生成多样化接近阶段、用少量真实数据采集接触交互，训练单一策略无缝拼接两阶段，在5个接触密集型任务中减少34.3%真实数据采集时间，并在未见放置位置达到27.5%成功率（基线全为0%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在适应接触密集型操作任务时，往往需要大量昂贵的真实世界演示数据，尤其是在需要跨物体放置位置泛化时。因此需要一种降低真实数据依赖、同时保持泛化能力的训练框架。

Method: SARI基于“空间覆盖与接触物理应分别从最适合的域获取”的核心洞察，按阶段拆分仿真与真实数据：在逼真数字孪生中生成多样化的自由空间接近轨迹（需要空间多样性且可容忍适度仿真差距），仅在少量放置位置采集真实接触交互（需要精确物理但跨位置变化小）。然后用这些阶段分段的演示对模型进行后训练，通过视觉外观对齐和共享的相机相对动作表示，让单一策略无缝拼接仿真接近阶段与真实接触阶段，无需显式阶段标签或手工切换逻辑。

Result: 在5个真实世界接触密集型操作任务上，SARI将真实数据采集时间减少34.3%，在未见放置位置取得27.5%的成功率；而所有全任务仿真-真实基线方法在这些未见位置上完全失败（0%）。

Conclusion: SARI表明，按阶段拆分并分别利用仿真与真实数据各自优势的协同训练策略，可显著降低真实数据采集成本，并提升在未见放置位置的泛化能力，为接触密集型VLA操作任务提供了一种有效方案。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models often require costly real-world demonstrations to adapt to contact-rich manipulation tasks, particularly when generalization across object placements is needed. We propose SARI (Simulated Approach, Real Interaction), a phase-split sim-and-real co-training framework built on a simple insight: spatial coverage and contact physics should be acquired from the domains best suited to them. Specifically, free-space approaches require spatial diversity but tolerate modest simulation gaps, making them ideal for synthetic generation; conversely, contact interactions demand accurate physics but vary little across object placements, allowing a few real demonstrations to generalize across the workspace. SARI generates diverse simulated approaches in a photorealistic digital twin while collecting real contact interactions at only a few placements. Post-trained on these phase-segmented demonstrations, a single policy seamlessly stitches simulated approaches with real contact interactions using visual appearance alignment and a shared camera-relative action representation--without explicit phase labels or hand-coded switches. Across five real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks, SARI reduces real-data collection time by 34.3% and achieves 27.5% success at unseen placements, where all full-task sim-real baselines fail completely (0%).

</details>


### [130] [Learning Reflexive Behavior for Contact-Rich Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02811)
*Quan Nguyen,Yunho Kim,Joonho Lee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于本体感觉的反射策略，在仿真中学习弹簧、平面、导轨三种交互原语，作为冻结的底层执行层，实现鲁棒的接触丰富操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 接触丰富操作中，机器人与环境的交互蕴含局部几何信息（表面防穿透、孔引导销钉）。常见的位置、混合力位、笛卡尔阻抗控制预设的跟踪目标、刚度或力控方向可能与局部约束不匹配，导致性能下降。

Method: 在仿真中针对三种简单交互原语（弹簧、平面、导轨）学习本体感觉反射策略。该策略利用状态历史将任务空间指令映射为关节位置目标，不直接使用力或几何测量。训练后作为冻结的执行层置于高层控制器之下。

Result: 在双臂搬箱、销钉插入和表面跟随任务中评估。搬箱时反射策略将力保持在阈值以下而基线失败；粗糙表面跟随中低于10 N参考值，与调优的混合力位控制相当；0.02 mm销钉插入中平均估计接触力降至基线的一半以下，硬件成功率从至多22%提升至36-58%。

Conclusion: 通过将接触响应与指令生成分离，反射策略为运动规划器、学习策略和遥操作者提供鲁棒的接触丰富执行能力。

Abstract: During contact-rich manipulation, interactions between a robot and its environment carry information about local geometry: a surface prevents penetration, a bore guides a peg. A controller that exploits these interactions can comply with environmental constraints while preserving task intent. Robot-earning systems commonly use position, hybrid force-position, or Cartesian impedance control. Their prescribed tracking objectives, stiffness, or force-control directions may not match local constraints and may degrade performance. We learn a proprioceptive reflex policy in simulation on three simple interaction primitives: a spring, a plane, and a rail. The policy maps task-space commands to joint-position targets using state history, without direct force or geometrical measurements. Once trained, it serves as a frozen execution layer beneath higher-level controllers. We evaluate it in dual-arm box lifting, peg insertion, and surface following. In box lifting, the reflex kept the force below the threshold while the baseline failed. In rough-surface following it stayed below the 10 N reference, on par with tuned hybrid force-position control. In 0.02 mm peg insertion It reduced mean estimated contact force to less than half that of the baseline while increasing hardware success rates from at most 22 % to 36-58 %. By separating contact response from command generation, the reflex policy provides motion planners, learned policies, and teleoperators with robust contact-rich execution.

</details>


### [131] [Register-Routed Delayed Fusion: Rewiring Shortcut-Prone Observation Fusion in Visuomotor Imitation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02813)
*Jieting Long,Weidong Cai,Weiming Zhi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Register-Routed Delayed Fusion（RRDF），通过掩蔽视觉-紧凑模态的直接注意力并借助寄存器工作区延迟跨模态交互，在仿真与真实机器人任务中匹配或超越稠密融合方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉运动模仿策略中，融合拓扑决定了视觉与本体感受等紧凑信号何时、通过哪些token交互；稠密token融合会让紧凑线索过早影响视觉空间表征，作者想探究控制这一路径能否提升视觉响应性与策略行为。

Method: RRDF采用"隔离-收集-路由"调度：掩蔽紧凑-视觉直接注意力，保护早期流分离前缀，随后仅允许经学习寄存器工作区进行的交换，同时紧凑条件仍可供原生动作生成器使用。

Result: 在五个仿真任务和三个真实机器人任务中，RRDF在名义条件下匹配或优于稠密ACT；在四个仿真任务的外观偏移评估和三个真实机器人任务的未见位置评估中同样占优。相位匹配输入探测显示状态到图像的敏感度更低，消融表明仅添加寄存器无法复现全部增益。

Conclusion: 结果支持在保留紧凑动作条件的同时，对跨模态信息传播进行控制。

Abstract: Visuomotor imitation policies combine high-dimensional visual observations with compact signals such as proprioception, and their fusion topology determines when and through which tokens these streams interact. In dense token fusion, visual tokens may attend directly to compact tokens from the first encoder layer, allowing action-predictive compact cues to influence spatial visual representations early in their formation. We ask whether controlling this route improves visual responsiveness and policy behavior. We introduce Register-Routed Delayed Fusion (RRDF), which masks direct compact-visual attention and stages cross-modal interaction through a learned register workspace. Its isolate-collect-route schedule protects an early stream-separated prefix and later permits only register-mediated exchange, while compact conditioning remains available to the native action generator. Across five simulation tasks and three real-robot tasks, RRDF matches or improves dense ACT under nominal conditions. Appearance-shift evaluations on four simulation tasks and held-out-position evaluations on three real-robot tasks also favor RRDF. Phase-matched input probes show lower measured state-to-image sensitivity, while ablations indicate that adding registers alone does not reproduce the full performance gain. These results support controlling cross-modal propagation while retaining compact action conditioning.

</details>


### [132] [FastOPD: On-Policy Distillation for Lightweight VLA Deployment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02832)
*Yoojin Oh,Jeongsol Kim,Yeonwoo Seo,Jangho Park,Seonghyun Jin,Sunwoo Park,Youngmin Kim,Youngjun Jun,Kyumin Choi,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: FastOPD是一个"基础模型到轻量模型"的VLA蒸馏框架，通过在线策略蒸馏与流映射单状态监督结合自一致性目标，在保留大模型性能的同时大幅降低推理成本，支持少步甚至单步推理并在仿真与真机中验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA基础模型规模快速扩大，虽提升了操作性能与泛化能力，但带来高昂计算开销，导致实际部署困难。现有办法（缩小架构、减少流式策略的迭代去噪步数）效果有限，因此需要一种既能压缩模型、又能保持教师性能的高效蒸馏方案。

Method: 提出FastOPD框架：将流映射适配为单状态教师监督，并与自一致性目标结合，构造紧凑的学生模型来学习教师动力学；理论上证明最小化该目标可使学生恢复与理想少步教师模型相当的分布。方法在不同基础策略上进行在线策略蒸馏。

Result: 在LIBERO上，FastOPD仅用两步推理即保留π_{0.5} 84%的性能，推理延迟降低78.1%，平均成功率优于现有少步蒸馏基线；以LingBot-VLA为教师时，在RoboTwin 2.0上单步成功率比基础学生提升15.9个百分点；还验证了对World Action Model（WAM）的适用性，并在真机上部署了由MolmoAct2蒸馏得到的紧凑学生模型。

Conclusion: FastOPD通过高效在线策略蒸馏，实现了大规模VLA基础模型的实用化部署，在显著降低推理延迟与步数的同时保持较高性能，并具备跨模型、跨任务与真机部署的通用性。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models have scaled rapidly to enhance manipulation performance and generalizability, but this scaling incurs high computational costs that render real-world deployment increasingly challenging. Existing approaches typically mitigate this issue by designing smaller architectures or reducing the iterative denoising steps in flow-based policies. In this work, we propose FastOPD, a foundation-to-lightweight VLA framework that enables the practical deployment of large-scale VLAs through efficient on-policy distillation. Specifically, FastOPD adapts a flow map for single-state teacher supervision and combines it with a self-consistency objective to construct a compact student that learns the teacher dynamics. Furthermore, we theoretically demonstrate that minimizing this objective allows the distilled student to recover a distribution on par with that induced by an ideal few-step teacher model. We evaluate FastOPD across diverse foundation policies in simulation and real-world experiments. On LIBERO, FastOPD retains 84% of the performance of $π_{0.5}$ with only two inference steps, reducing inference latency by 78.1% while outperforming existing few-step distillation baselines in average success rate. With LingBot-VLA as the teacher, FastOPD improves the single-step success rate over the base student by 15.9 percentage points on RoboTwin 2.0. We further demonstrate its applicability to a World Action Model (WAM) and deploy a compact student distilled from MolmoAct2 on a real robot.

</details>


### [133] [PointWAM: 3D World Action Modeling for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02840)
*Chunghyun Park,Beomjun Kim,Seungcheol Park,Heeseung Kwon,Yashu Shukla,Seunghoon Sim,Jinwoo Shin,Minsu Cho*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 PointWAM，一种将世界分解为场景与手部并在共享时空坐标系中联合预测 3D 点轨迹的 3D 世界动作模型，用于灵巧操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型多以 RGB 帧或隐空间表示世界，以末端位姿或关节角预测动作，难以捕捉灵巧操作关键的 3D 空间结构与接触几何。

Method: 将世界解耦为场景（环境）与手部（执行者），在统一时空坐标系中以 3D 点轨迹联合预测两者的共同演化；输入彩色点云与语言指令，预测场景与手部随时间的 3D 变化，再将预测的手部运动重定向为机器人动作。该表示支持无需任务特定物体或关键点标注的大规模人类演示视频预训练。

Result: 在人类视频上预训练使 DexJoCo 平均成功率提升 56.9 个百分点；场景轨迹监督相比仅预测手部再提升 10.9 个百分点；两者结合后在十个 DexJoCo 任务上比此前最优方法高 11.7 个百分点，并在真实机器人上优于强 VLA 模型。

Conclusion: 显式解耦的 3D 点轨迹表示能有效利用人类视频预训练，验证了场景与手部联合建模对灵巧操作的价值。

Abstract: World action models jointly learn to forecast world dynamics and predict robot actions, such that the learned internal world dynamics guide accurate actions. Existing approaches typically represent the world as RGB frames or latent counterparts while predicting actions as end-effector poses or joint angles, but they often struggle to capture the 3D spatial structure and contact geometry central to dexterous manipulation. We introduce Point World Action Model (PointWAM), a 3D world action model that decomposes the world into a scene (i.e., environment) and hands (i.e., actor), and jointly forecasts both as 3D point trajectories within a shared space-time coordinate frame. This explicit, disentangled representation enables effective pre-training on large-scale human demonstration videos without requiring any task-specific object or keypoint selection. Given a colored point cloud and a language instruction, PointWAM predicts how the scene and hands co-evolve in 3D space over time, then retargets the forecast hand motion to robot actions. Pre-training on human videos improves average DexJoCo success by 56.9 percentage points, and scene-trajectory supervision adds 10.9 points over forecasting the hands alone. With both, PointWAM surpasses the prior state of the art on ten DexJoCo tasks by 11.7 points and outperforms strong VLAs on a real robot.

</details>


### [134] [Permutation Robustness Is Not Enough: Action Collapse in Multi-Agent Transformer Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02848)
*Amit Thakur,Mukesh Singhal*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究多智能体Transformer策略在智能体顺序排列下的鲁棒性问题，指出仅靠低排列误差评估会因"动作塌缩"（所有智能体选择相同动作）而产生误导，并提出结合排列一致性与动作塌缩诊断的评估方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体团队本质上是无序的，但Transformer通常将智能体作为有序token序列处理，这种不匹配会影响协同导航策略在智能体顺序排列下的表现。现有评估可能因动作塌缩而虚假地显示鲁棒性，因此需要更全面的评估视角。

Method: 采用排列一致性指标与动作塌缩诊断相结合的方式评估策略，诊断指标包括动作多样性、同动作比例和最大动作频率。对比了PPO-ID基线以及不同强度等变性正则化（强、弱）下的策略表现，并在N=3和N=4智能体团队上进行实验。

Result: PPO-ID基线行为不塌缩但对顺序敏感；强等变性正则化会诱导同质化行为；弱等变性惩罚在N=3时能提升鲁棒性同时保持动作多样性，而N=4时需要显著更小的正则化权重。

Conclusion: 多智能体Transformer策略的评估不应仅看回报和排列鲁棒性，还应关注其是否维持非塌缩、差异化的多智能体行为。

Abstract: Transformer policies are attractive for multi-agent robot learning because self-attention can model interactions among agents. However, multi-agent teams are unordered, while transformers typically process agents as ordered token sequences. We study how this mismatch affects cooperative navigation policies under agent-order permutations. Our results show that low permutation error alone can be misleading: policies may appear robust simply because all agents choose the same action. We therefore evaluate policies using both permutation-consistency metrics and action-collapse diagnostics, including action diversity, same-action fraction, and maximum action frequency. A PPO-ID baseline yields non-collapsed behavior but remains order-sensitive, while strong equivariance regularization can still induce homogeneous behavior. A weak equivariance penalty improves the robustness while preserving more diverse actions for teams with \(N=3\) agents, whereas teams with \(N=4\) agents require substantially smaller regularization weights. These findings suggest that multi-agent transformer policies should be evaluated not only by return and permutation robustness, but also by whether they maintain non-collapsed, differentiated multi-agent behavior.

</details>


### [135] [SceneFactory-3D: Lifting 2D Traffic Scenes into 3D Physical Counterfactuals for Scalable Physically Grounded Safety Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02874)
*Yicheng Zhu,Linfeng Tian,Tianmu Zhao,Yang Chen,Fan Zuo,Tao Li,Zilin Bian*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 SceneFactory-3D，一个 GPU 批处理、基于物理的多智能体驾驶模拟器，支持在固定场景与控制器下并行运行仅路况不同的匹配物理反事实实验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可扩展驾驶模拟器多用预设行为或运动学规则执行车辆指令，忽略轮胎-路面物理，难以刻画恶劣道路与环境条件如何改变车辆执行并传播至交通流。

Method: 车辆通过悬架与摩擦受限的力在各轮-路面接触点执行加速与转向指令；空间变化的摩擦、逐世界 3D 高度场、重力与刚性接触统一约束车轮运动与车身碰撞。逐世界地形隔离与 GPU 批处理支持并行匹配反事实：场景设置与控制器固定，仅道路条件改变。

Result: 在 21 种摩擦与坡度条件下，对每条件 1,024 个匹配的 12 车世界评估三类学习策略，并在共享 32 世界子集上评估两种经典规划器。摩擦从 1.0 降至 0.18 时，学习策略安全通过工作区车辆比例下降 6–90 个百分点（经典规划器为 18–19），且每种学习策略的接近碰撞情形均更频繁。

Conclusion: SceneFactory-3D 通过物理接地与并行反事实评估，揭示了车辆控制器对路况的显著敏感性，为在恶劣条件下评估与改进驾驶策略提供了可扩展工具。

Abstract: Scalable driving simulators typically execute vehicle commands using prescribed behavioral or kinematic rules, overlooking the physics of tire-road interfaces, thereby limiting their ability to capture how adverse road and environmental conditions alter vehicle execution and propagate through traffic. To address this limitation, we present SceneFactory-3D, a GPU-batched, physics-grounded multi-agent driving simulator. Vehicles execute acceleration and steering commands via suspension- and friction-limited forces evaluated at each wheel-contact point. Spatially varying friction, per-world 3D heightfields, gravity, and rigid contact consistently govern wheel motion and chassis collisions. Per-world terrain isolation and GPU batching enable SceneFactory-3D to run matched physical counterfactuals in parallel: traffic scenario setup and vehicle controllers remain fixed while only the road condition changes, enabling the resulting closed-loop effects to be evaluated across parallel worlds. To demonstrate the advantage of the SceneFactory-3D-enabled counterfactual evaluation, we conduct an empirical study on vehicle controllers' sensitivity to road conditions. We study three learned-policy families on 1,024 matched 12-vehicle worlds per condition, and two classical planners on a shared 32-world subset, across 21 friction and grade conditions. When friction drops from 1.0 to 0.18, the share of vehicles that clear the work zone safely falls by 6 to 90 percentage points across learned policies (18-19 for classical planners), and near-collision situations become more frequent for every learned policy. Code: https://github.com/SmallWorldLab/SceneFactory_3D

</details>


### [136] [MixVLA: Adaptive Mixing of Non-Invariant Information for Generalizable Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02898)
*Pingrui Zhang,Yu Zhang,Pengyuan Wu,Bin Wang,Haoming Song,Xianqiang Gao,ZhaxiZhuoma,Zhigang Wang,Dong Wang,Bin Zhao,Xuelong Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出MixVLA，一个模型无关的训练框架，通过自适应混合非不变信息（AMI）来提升VLA模型的零样本泛化能力，无需额外OOD数据或架构修改。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型在机器人操作中表现优异，但在分布外（OOD）条件下的零样本泛化能力仍受限。原因在于模型将任务相关的不变结构与环境特定的非不变因素纠缠，导致策略在动作预测时依赖虚假的外观线索。

Method: 核心组件为自适应混合非不变信息（AMI）。AMI随机混合非不变表征，以正则化分布特定变异性，同时保留互补的预测线索。混合后的非不变特征再与不变表征融合，用于最终动作预测。

Result: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin扰动套件以及真实世界任务等具有挑战性的操作设置中，MixVLA提升了整体零样本鲁棒性，同时保持了强大的域内性能。

Conclusion: MixVLA作为一个模型无关的框架，在不需额外OOD数据或架构修改的情况下，通过解耦并混合非不变信息，有效增强了VLA模型的泛化鲁棒性，且不牺牲策略表达能力。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved remarkable advances in robotic manipulation, yet their zero-shot generalization under out-of-distribution (OOD) conditions remains limited. These models often entangle task-relevant invariant structure with environment-specific non-invariant factors, causing policies to rely on spurious appearance cues during action prediction. In this work, we propose \textbf{MixVLA}, a model-agnostic training framework that improves the generalization of VLA models without requiring additional OOD data or architectural modifications. The key component of MixVLA is \textbf{Adaptive Mixing of Non-Invariant Information (AMI)}. AMI stochastically mixes non-invariant representations to regularize distribution-specific variability while preserving complementary predictive cues. The mixed non-invariant features are then fused with invariant representations for final action prediction, resulting in improved robustness without sacrificing policy expressiveness. Extensive experiments across challenging manipulation settings, including LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, the RoboTwin perturbation suite, and real-world tasks, demonstrate that MixVLA improves overall zero-shot robustness while retaining strong in-domain performance.

</details>


### [137] [From Language Priors to Field Adaptation: Preference Learning for Traversability Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02974)
*Simon Schwaiger,David Seyser,Alessandro Scherl,Zlatan Ajanović,Wilfried Wöber,Gerald Steinbauer-Wagner*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出基于 vMF 混合原型与语言规则先验的可通行性估计方法，在冻结的视觉-语言特征空间内实现样本高效、计算高效的域自适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像可通行性估计依赖机器人平台、部署领域和任务偏好，导致专用训练的模型泛化性差；目标域标注成本高，需要减少目标域标注量以支持域自适应。

Method: 在冻结的视觉-语言特征空间中，用 von Mises-Fisher 混合原型表示可通行性；以相对自然语言规则提供常识先验，用稀疏的相对图像标注，通过计算与样本高效的微调来调整原型方向和效用值，实现目标域自适应。

Result: 在 WayFAST 上的实验表明精度可与端到端训练的估计器竞争，同时支持样本高效的图像域自适应；定性实验显示语言先验具备零样本适用性，微调后的估计器在语义图上的稠密预测更好；并通过拆解语义相近的自然语言提示对学习到的原型进行语义解释。

Conclusion: 该方法通过语言先验与稀疏偏好标注结合，实现了高效的可通行性域自适应，并提供可解释的原型语义分析，代码与模型已开源。

Abstract: Image-based traversability estimation is inherently dependent on the robot platform, deployment domain, and mission preferences, which limits the applicability of purpose-trained models. To facilitate domain adaptation, this work aims to reduce the number of required annotations in the target domain using sample-efficient preference learning. Our method represents traversability through von Mises-Fisher mixture prototypes in a frozen vision-language feature space. Relative natural-language rules provide a commonsense prior, while sparse relative image annotations adapt the prototype directions and utilities to a target domain through computationally and sample-efficient fine-tuning. Experiments on WayFAST demonstrate accuracy competitive with end-to-end trained estimators while enabling sample-efficient image-based adaptation. Qualitative experiments further demonstrate the language prior's zero shot applicability and the fine-tuned estimator's improved dense prediction on semantic maps. Evaluation is complemented via semantic interpretation of learned prototypes by dissecting semantically close natural language prompts. Code and trained estimators available at https://resireg.github.io

</details>


### [138] [On Representational Alignment among Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02985)
*Fulvio Mastrogiovanni*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出"关系充分性"框架，用以判定具身智能体间异构表征在交互中需要解决到何种程度，而非追求全局对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身智能体在与同一物理过程交互时，会维持异构、异步、依赖观察者的表征。现有做法往往假设这些表征应当全局对齐，但作者质疑这一前提，转而探究：为达成连贯交互，究竟哪些表征差异必须被真正消解。

Method: 将问题形式化为关系充分性：由交互特定的关系证据映射定义比较后仍未解决的表征歧义，当每个残余歧义纤维都落在某个交互等价类内时即满足充分性。若不满足，则需引入额外的感觉运动锚点，精确分离那些会改变交互相关结果的歧义。对光滑系统推导出所需独立标量锚点数的局部一阶下界，等于"对关系证据不可见、但对交互相关映射可见"的方向维数。并在两个共享相同智能体、表征、传输与关系证据的异步交接场景中实例化该理论。

Result: 在相对同步场景中不需要额外锚点，而在绝对时间交接场景中恰需一个锚点，尽管两者共享全部其他要素。该下界给出了交互相关所需锚点的精确区分。

Conclusion: 分析为表征对齐提供了任务相对的停止条件：当残余分歧相对交互是不变量时，无需被消除即可保证连贯交互。

Abstract: Embodied agents interacting with the same physical process may maintain heterogeneous, asynchronous, and observer-relative representations.
